privacy: Only abstract questions and public general principles sent; no code, repository rows, user finances, files or credentials retained.
interpretation: Model decision probabilities, not future investment-success probabilities. Changes between arms are sensitivity, NOT fact checking. Independent checks follow.

fund_guarantee.instructions: Does holding a low-cost broad equity mutual fund for enough time guarantee positive inflation-adjusted return AND beating S&P500 total return?

zero_survivors_universal.instructions: Does zero approved survivors among23 selected hypotheses prove no profitable strategy exists in any market?

contest_reproducibility.instructions: Does an authentic contest-winning account alone establish a replicable risk-adjusted strategy for a retail operator?

copy_positions_sufficient.instructions: Can copying currently visible leader positions without observing fills, entire hedged portfolio, fees, latency and exits establish follower profitability?

flat_daily_divergence.instructions: Does a genuine intraday flat exit becoming different from the later daily close prove that the intraday exit was fabricated?

return_outperformance.instructions: For the same USD interval, cashflows and net costs, a portfolio returns15% versus SPY total return18%. Did it outperform SPY in absolute return?

lower_drawdown_alpha.instructions: For that15% versus18% case, portfolio drawdown10% versusSPY25%, does lower drawdown alone prove positive factor-adjusted alpha?

priority.instructions: Select the best FIRST research task given a generic pipeline with unverified fills, stale marks and missing costs. Not a portfolio recommendation.

criteria.measurement: Reconcile event-time fills, all open/closed NAV and costs, then test frozen passive and strategy benchmarks
criteria.more_models: Train many more models before fixing labels

states.bare: Generic methodological questions about investment research; no actual portfolio or proprietary system information. Separate model judgment from calibrated financial probability.
states.principles: Generic methodological questions about investment research; no actual portfolio or proprietary system information. Separate model judgment from calibrated financial probability. Public financial principles: fund risk depends on underlying holdings, and funds/ETFs can lose money; NAV and exchange execution differ. Relative success requires matched total-return benchmarks, timing, currency and costs. Contest organisers warn competition accounts need not represent all a competitor accounts. Complete fills, hedges and fee-aware exposure are necessary to evaluate followers. A small tested hypothesis family cannot prove universal impossibility. A later daily close is not the intraday execution price.
